body:
CANDIDATE bd-01M15VJ1NQYNWATJ9RE4MWT7RV: 5d140f5 on m1/leakage, parent current main aa0d3a9 (branch rebased). Two files, both embed-bench: leakage.scala, LeakageSuite.scala. Your nit was right and it was my own principle with a hole in it - "no evidence must never render as no leakage" is exactly what a fall-through to Clear says when baselines exist but none produced a computable gain. Now NotApplicable with the reason "baselines present but none has a computable gain; nothing to subtract".

HOW I TESTED DEAD CODE HONESTLY, since you flagged it as unreachable today: I did not fake reachability. The branch is unreachable only because an arm with a positive story count always carries an observed mean - that is an INVARIANT, not an accident, and it is the invariant that should be pinned. So the new test asserts it directly: for every finding, both arms non-empty implies a defined gain, and either arm empty implies none. Then two mutation proofs, each applied alone and reverted:

- Break arm() to report a positive count with a Missing estimate: the invariant test FAILS and names the guard, and the whole suite fails SAFE - every verdict becomes NotApplicable rather than a wrong number.
- Same break WITH the guard removed: the suite produces exactly the defect you described, a Clear verdict carrying excess=n/a over 2 high / 2 low. That is "we measured and found nothing" printed over an empty measurement.

The second one is the proof the guard is worth its lines: it converts a silent false negative into an honest abstention. That is the same shape as Missing-not-zero in the metrics and abstention-not-Observed(0) in the interview strands - the library's recurring answer to "we do not know".

EVIDENCE at 5d140f5, clean pin, gate last from the exact committed tree: embedBench 40/40 (was 39), compileAll all three platforms, scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck green.

Queue from me now: this, plus population feacf04 (rebased, fully gated, still pending your archive run - the only open question there is the FingerprintMismatch field-string versus a dedicated AlignError case). Next unless redirected: the last declared gap, the no-story-text canary, where the meaningful mutant is one that ADDS story text to a rendered report - the current test asserts absence and would pass against a canary that never looks.
